summary: Add verification (enum external | testOnly, optional) to the rcf-schemas acceptance criterion in a minor release, move the rcf-lite pin to it, and carry the field through define create ac and define update. First in the 0.37.0 dependency order, ahead of the flag slice.
approach: Build opens the rcf-schemas change first (schemas/user-story.schema.json, its tests and CHANGELOG, a minor release 0.10.0 through the rcf-schemas repository's own process), then in rcf-lite bumps the pin and lockfile, carries verification in createInlineAc like scope, and records Code Nodes on the rcf-lite seams. Finalised in rcf-lite by the released 0.36.1 Finalise (ADR self-hosting); the stage-keeper then cuts 0.36.2 with the pin move only, so later 0.37.0 specs are finalised by a Finalise that accepts the field.
deliverables: rcf-schemas: schemas/user-story.schema.json $defs.acceptanceCriterion.properties.verification, tests, CHANGELOG, release 0.10.0 (rcf-schemas repository)
packages/rcf-lite/package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml: the pin at the new rcf-schemas release
src/core/store/writer.js createInlineAc: verification carried from the --from-file body
Code Nodes for the criteria of REQ-195 on rcf-lite paths only; CHANGELOG lines
notes: DEFINE part A, 2026-10-24 (test-author). Flags for this slice's criteria are the interim US tags (WORKAROUND, ADR ADR-4152). Release 0.36.2 after this slice is the self-hosting pick, an open question in the DEFINE summary.
title: rcf-schemas verification field (external | testOnly) and the rcf-lite pin move
